notes.title: Bug Fixes are out NOW!
notes.content:
Whats new :
Elina is even smarter. You can ask her to see what's your current coins balance, or to start a coinflip.
Website upgraded (https://aliengarden.com/play)
Players now start in the overworld
New Wet stat effect when in water
New Burning stat effect when in lava
Better tiles, especially in the wet lands

Thanks to the people that provided insightful feedback : @PlatosPoet , @Jexhee (?) , @Myrkur , @Bread and @runes 

Fixes : 
Balun no longer instantly teleports to the player in his 'chase' phase
(WIP) added profanity filtering for chats, usernames
Deep blue water no longer crashes the client
Tooltip no longer duplicates and glitches
Biome title is now centered
Slots with items are no longer offset
Fixed line break in description of classes
Removed duplicate portal name
Removed HP/HP/MP text from bars
Made World Alerts use the same font as the rest of UI elements
Moved Experience bar (XP) at the bottom of the screen, moved minimap and settings up
Better screen layout for minimap and quest icon
